preToolUse.bash: cd "${PLUGIN_ROOT:-.}" 2>/dev/null; if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 tools/guard.py; elif command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python tools/guard.py; else in=$(cat); if printf %s "$in" | grep -Eq 'legacy[\\/]' && ! printf %s "$in" | grep -Eq '"tool_?[nN]ame"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"(view|read|read_file|glob|grep|search|ls|rg|list_dir)"'; then printf '%s\n' '{"permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"modernize guard: no Python 3 was found to check this call, so it is blocked because it mentions legacy/. Install Python 3.9+ and restart Copilot."}'; fi; fi
preToolUse.powershell: if ($env:PLUGIN_ROOT) { Set-Location -LiteralPath $env:PLUGIN_ROOT }; $f = [IO.Path]::GetTempFileName(); [IO.File]::WriteAllText($f, [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(), [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)); try { if (Get-Command py -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { & py -3 tools\guard.py --input $f } elseif (Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { & python tools\guard.py --input $f } elseif (Get-Command python3 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { & python3 tools\guard.py --input $f } else { $raw = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($f); if (($raw -match 'legacy[\\/]') -and ($raw -notmatch '"tool_?[nN]ame"\s*:\s*"(view|read|read_file|glob|grep|search|ls|rg|list_dir)"')) { '{"permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"modernize guard: no Python 3 was found to check this call, so it is blocked because it mentions legacy/. Install Python 3.9+ and restart Copilot."}' } } } finally { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $f -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
